title: La guía de estados
description: The combat guide (src/status-guide.ts): the first time a status shows on a plate, the party's or a foe's, the fight stops behind a card that says what it does; read, it is kept, and «Cómo jugar» → En combate shows every card found. A card whose words or numbers changed since it was read shows again, «HA CAMBIADO». Cards are off in automated browsers unless the page asks (?guides=1). Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.gerard.battleUI.tweak(s => { s.foes[0].timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 10, next: 2 } }; })

steps.caption: Quemado shows for the first time, on a dog: the fight stops behind its card
The fight's clock stands still while the card is up

steps.eval: window.gerard.battleUI.tweak(s => { s.allies[0].statuses = { sangrado: 3 }; s.foes[1].timed = { confusion: { level: 1, left: 30, next: 30 } }; })

steps.caption: Two new at once: the first (Sangrado, on Gerard) …
… then the next, Confusión on another dog
Read: the fight goes on, and the same statuses never stop it again

steps.eval: window.gerard.battleUI.tweak(s => { s.foes[2].timed = { quemado: { level: 1, left: 10, next: 2 } }; s.foes[0].timed = { confusion: { level: 1, left: 30, next: 30 } }; })

steps.caption: Quemado's card was read at an older version: it shows again, «HA CAMBIADO»; Confusión, read as it is, does not
Cómo jugar: the controls, and beside the title the two views
En combate: every card found, by group, and the one under the cursor
Moving through them shows each one's card
